summary: The underlying index is composed of U.S. dollar denominated, taxable, fixed-rate, high yield and BBB or equivalently rated corporate bonds scheduled to mature between January 1, 2033 and December 15, 2033, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component instruments of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
